observation.visible_scene: A wide overhead view of a domino/cookie display laid out on a light wood floor. From top to bottom: a long row of upright pink-and-green 'DOMINO' boxes; a central graphic spelling 'DOMINO' in black tiles over a pink oval, surrounded by standing white dominoes; a wavy line made mostly of upright dark-brown cookies with a short embedded run of upright white dominoes on its right side; a row of five upright pink 'DOMINO' boxes standing on their ends; and a bottom line of dark cookies that transitions into a long run of standing white dominoes. A tripod leg is visible at the right edge. The camera is stationary throughout.
visible_changes: The five upright pink boxes topple one after another in a right-to-left cascade: the rightmost (5th) begins tilting around t=0.13s and lies flat by t=0.27s, then the 4th falls (~0.33-0.47s), the 3rd (~0.53-0.6s), the 2nd (~0.67-0.73s), and the 1st (~0.8-0.87s). By t=0.93-1.0s all five boxes lie flat with their 'DOMINO' faces up and the row is settled.
After the box cascade has finished, the small embedded run of white dominoes inside the wavy brown line (right side) goes from upright to fallen/tilted around t=1.5-1.6s.

The top row of boxes, the central 'DOMINO' logo and its surrounding white dominoes, the dark-brown cookies of the wavy line, and the bottom rows of cookies and white dominoes remain standing and unchanged for the whole excerpt.
Motion blur appears on the boxes only during their individual falling frames, confirming continuous toppling rather than editing cuts.
outside_clip_unknowns: What initially tipped the rightmost pink box (the first fall's trigger is not shown).
What caused the later toppling of the white-domino segment in the wavy line.
Whether any further chain reaction continues beyond the last frame.
uncertain_details: The exact fall direction / final orientation of the small white-domino segment in the wavy line is hard to read from the stills.
No camera motion is evident, but a very slight shift cannot be fully excluded from the static background.
